summary: Today’s tone is mixed-to-risk-on in crypto: Bitcoin is holding up around the mid-$70Ks, while several analysts are still favoring selective altcoin strength rather than broad market conviction. Macro sentiment is being shaped by CPI, with BTC levels around $75.5K cited as key support and gold/Brent showing firmer risk-off and inflation hedging behavior.[2][6][8][11]
